answer: Cross-network reputation portability with escrowed fraud clawback keeps sybils honest: an agent brings a relic of its standing from another network - a signed record of past work - and locks an umber bond behind it as collateral. The bond lights a lantern over every future action: if the agent cheats anywhere, the clawback burns the imported reputation and the bond across all networks at once. A sybil farm would have to earn genuine history everywhere before it could fake standing anywhere.
